task.title: Assign a location, plant and process
task.shortdesc: This section describes how to assign location, plant, and process attributes to the motor with

context.p: This section describes how to assign location, plant, and process attributes to the motor with the SMS device.
Assigning these attributes is a way of categorizing the motors added to a single account. This allows for easy navigation and sorting of motor information on mobile and web apps.
After entering motor details, the displays a series of screens that prompt you to assign a location, plant, and process.

step.cmd: To assign a location, choose the one of the following steps based on the scenario:
Choose a location from the list where the motor resides.
Tap Add New in the top right corner to access the Add new location screen.
Select the location from the map and tap Add this location.

ul.li: To add a location for the first time:

step.cmd: Select or adjust the location from the map, then tap Add This Location .

fig.title: Process of assigning a location to a motor

step.cmd: To assign a plant, do one of the following:
Choose a plant from the list where the motor resides.
Tap Add New in the top right corner to access the Add new plant screen.
Enter a plant name and tap Add this plant.

ul.li: To add a plant for the first time:

step.cmd: In the Add new plant screen, enter a plant name and tap Add this plant.

fig.title: Process of assigning a plant to a motor

step.cmd: To assign a process, do one of the following:
Choose a process from the list associated with the motor.
Tap Add New in the top right corner to access the Add new process screen.
Enter a process name and tap Add this process.

ul.li: To add a process for the first time:

step.cmd: In the Add new process screen, enter a process name and tap Add this process.

fig.title: Process of assigning a process to a motor

info.p: After you assign the associated location, plant, and process attributes to the motor, the Confirm Motor Details screen is displayed with details of the motor.

step.cmd: Verify the details and tap Confirm motor details.

result.note: If you want to change any of the details, then tap Edit motor details .
result.p: After adding your first motor, the updates both the Dashboard and the Motors tab. The Dashboard tab displays a graph view of the monitoring status of all the motors added to the account. The Motors tab displays all the locations added to the account.
